recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes to this extension's context list should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack rather than in the FHIR core checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-27829 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested adding CapabilityStatement.format to the allowed contexts for http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/capabilitystatement-expectation.
initial_application: Core commit 5b129917061c5f19861dfc5326f95b4be59d507c applied FHIR-27829 together with FHIR-20196 by adding CapabilityStatement.format to source/capabilitystatement/structuredefinition-extension-capabilitystatement-expectation.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes for 2020-06-22 corroborate the Jira vote. The extension StructureDefinition was later removed from core by dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 as part of moving extensions out of the R5 source. Current core fhir.ini has no active profile entry for capabilitystatement-expectation, while the Extension Pack checkout contains the authoritative definition and still lists CapabilityStatement.format.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. Editing the FHIR core checkout would not update the authoritative extension definition; the current external source already satisfies the seed request.
